verdict.rationale: Grafana has a dedicated OpenTelemetry docs section for collecting metrics, logs, traces, and profiles without vendor lock-in (grafana-docs-38). Tempo accepts OpenTelemetry tracing protocols (grafana-docs-37), and Mimir stores OpenTelemetry metrics (grafana-docs-53). However, nothing in the pack explicitly documents sending OTLP directly to an endpoint, and log ingestion is described as going through Grafana Alloy (grafana-docs-57). missing for 10: explicit documentation of direct OTLP ingestion endpoints across all signals, OTLP log ingestion without Alloy, independent or hands-on corroboration of OTLP usage.
